remove_dups([], []).

% insert_sorted(+X, +Sorted, -Result)
insert_sorted(X, [], [X]).
insert_sorted(X, [H|T], [X,H|T]) :-
    X =< H.
insert_sorted(X, [H|T], [H|R]) :-
    X > H,
    insert_sorted(X, T, R).

% subset_sum(+List, +Sum, -Subset)
subset_sum([], 0, []).
subset_sum([H|T], Sum, [H|Sub]) :-
    Sum2 is Sum - H,
    Sum2 >= 0,
    subset_sum(T, Sum2, Sub).
subset_sum([_|T], Sum, Sub) :-
    subset_sum(T, Sum, Sub).
